idea.hook: SEND ME ONE LISTING. I'LL SHOW YOU.

slides.heading: SEND ME ONE LISTING. I'LL **SHOW** YOU.
slides.body: See the fixes on your own listing, not someone else's.

slides.heading: YOUR LISTING ISN'T BAD. IT'S **INVISIBLE**.
slides.body: Most agents think they need more listings. You don't. You need the ones you have to get noticed.

slides.heading: **GUESSING** WHAT'S WRONG
slides.body: You post. A few likes, no messages. You try new hashtags, a new filter. Still nothing. And you never find out why.

slides.heading: PACKAGE IT TO BE **NOTICED**
slides.body: The fix isn't more money on ads. It's the same listing, packaged so buyers notice it, understand it and act.

slides.heading: WHAT I **CHECK** FIRST
bullets: Photo order: is your best shot first?
Hook: does the first second say why to stop?

slides.heading: HOW THE **FREE** REVIEW WORKS
bullets: Send: photos of one current listing.
Where: WhatsApp, Instagram DM or text.
I show you: how I'd turn it into a premium video and post.

slides.heading: SEND PHOTOS. I'LL DO THE **REST**.
slides.body: I turn your photos into premium listing videos, write the captions and post them. No filming. One extra rental a month covers it.

slides.heading: LET'S LOOK AT **YOUR** LISTING
slides.body: DM me REVIEW and I'll look at one of your listings

caption:
Stop guessing what's wrong with your listing posts. Send me one and I'll show you.

Most listings aren't bad. They're just not packaged to be noticed.
Send photos of one current listing by WhatsApp, Instagram DM or text.
I'll show you how I'd turn it into a premium video and post. It's free.

DM me REVIEW and I'll look at one of your listings.
